enriched_activities.activity: Asleep, phone on charger on the desk, air conditioner on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Extend arm. Pull blanket up. Turn onto right side. Bend knees. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Shower, take morning chronic-condition medication, brush teeth and dress for the on-site shift
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Open medicine cabinet. Take out medication bottle. Open bottle. Take pill. Swallow. Close bottle. Put back. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Finish dressing, put on desk lamp, quietly read and reply to one-on-one text messages on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Close door. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read text message. Type reply. Send reply. Read next message. Type reply. Send. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Boil kettle, make toast, eat breakfast at the counter, pack a lunch and refill water bottle (kitchen free before Member 3's 07:00 breakfast)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle. Boil water. Place bread in toaster. Toast bread. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Spread butter on toast. Take out lunch container. Pack lunch. Refill water bottle. Eat breakfast at counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Walk the dog around the neighbourhood block and back
enriched_activities.desc: Put leash on dog. Open front door. Walk out. Close door. Walk down steps. Turn left. Walk along sidewalk. Dog pulls. Stop. Wait for dog to sniff. Continue walking. Turn right at corner. Walk around block. Cross street. Wait for traffic light. Continue. Return to house. Open door. Remove leash. Let dog in. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: School run and drop-off, escorting child to the school gate on foot and by bus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk with child to bus stop. Hold child's hand. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit with child. Talk to child. Get off bus. Walk to school gate. Hug child. Say goodbye. Watch child enter. Walk back to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Return home.

enriched_activities.activity: Public transit commute across town to the clinic for the on-site shift (no EV needed; Member 2 has taken the electric vehicle to work)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Get off bus. Transfer to train. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Sit. Get off train. Walk to clinic. Enter clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: On-site clinic duties: patient intake, blood pressure and medication checks, community health paperwork
enriched_activities.desc: Greet patient at desk. Ask for name and ID. Enter data into computer. Take blood pressure cuff. Wrap around patient's arm. Inflate cuff. Release valve. Read measurement. Record in chart. Ask about medication. Check medication list. Provide advice. Hand out forms. Collect forms. File paperwork. Answer phone. Schedule appointment.

enriched_activities.activity: Short lunch break near the clinic, eating packed food and texting relatives
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bench. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open messaging app. Read message. Type reply. Send. Continue eating. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Pack up. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Primary education aide duties at the school: classroom support, student welfare notes, staff handover
enriched_activities.desc: Enter classroom. Greet teacher. Assist students with tasks. Walk around room. Help student with worksheet. Collect papers. Write notes on student behavior. Attend staff meeting. Discuss student progress. Hand over notes to teacher. Organize classroom materials. Escort students to lunch. Supervise playground. Return to classroom. Prepare materials for next lesson.

enriched_activities.activity: Community outreach visits and follow-up appointments with local clients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to client's house. Knock on door. Greet client. Enter house. Sit down. Discuss health concerns. Check blood pressure. Provide medication. Fill out form. Ask questions. Record answers. Say goodbye. Walk to next client. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Public transit journey home with a cash-budget grocery stop on the way
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay cash. Sit. Get off at grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk aisles. Select items. Check prices. Go to checkout. Pay cash. Receive change. Bag groceries. Exit store. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Get off near home. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpack groceries, cook dinner using induction cooker and rice cooker, feed the dog
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Unpack groceries. Put away items. Measure rice. Add water. Start rice cooker. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Cook vegetables. Stir. Turn off cooker. Scoop food into bowls. Feed dog.

enriched_activities.activity: Family dinner, air conditioner on, unhurried conversation during the meal; Member 3 joins at the table for dinner from 18:30
enriched_activities.desc: Set table. Place plates. Place utensils. Sit at table with Member 2. Serve food. Eat. Talk to Member 2. Ask about day. Listen. Member 3 arrives. Greet Member 3. Serve food to Member 3. Continue eating. Pass dishes. Discuss plans. Finish meal. Clear plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Remote paperwork and community outreach scheduling on the computer, checking the roster for the next shift, working alongside Member 3 who is doing homework
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open scheduling software. Check roster. Type notes. Update patient records. Send emails. Schedule appointments. Check calendar. Print documents. File papers. Answer phone. Make call to client. Confirm appointment.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening dog walk along the quiet street to settle the dog before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Put leash on dog. Open door. Walk out. Walk along street. Dog sniffs. Stop. Continue. Turn around. Walk back. Enter house. Remove leash. Give dog treat.

enriched_activities.activity: One-on-one text check-ins with relatives and neighbours on phone, reviewing every detail of the day, sharing the living room with Member 2 who is relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open messaging app. Select relative. Read messages. Type reply. Send. Select next relative. Repeat. Nod to Member 2. Continue texting.

enriched_activities.activity: Wash up, take evening medication, lay out tomorrow's clothes, dehumidifier running
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Take medication. Open medicine cabinet. Take out bottle. Open. Take pill. Swallow. Close. Put back. Lay out clothes on chair. Turn on dehumidifier. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidy the kitchen, load the dishwasher, start a load of laundry and set out breakfast items
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Wipe counters. Put dishes in dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start cycle. Gather laundry. Walk to laundry room. Load washing machine. Add detergent. Start machine. Return to kitchen. Set out bowls. Set out cereal. Set out cups.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind down in bed with the TV off, dim desk lamp, final phone text replies and calming routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Dim lamp. Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type replies. Send. Turn off phone. Place phone on charger. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Asleep for the night, air conditioner on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Remain asleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn onto side. Pull blanket. Remain asleep. Extend arm. Bend knees. Turn onto back. Remain asleep.
